what: The app's signal-quality gate (SignalQuality.kt; reference signal_quality.py). The kurtosis and band-share thresholds are the published-convention values the app has always used and are not calibrated on our hardware. The artifact check is new in sqi2.

artifact.what: The display signal is cut into consecutive 1 s blocks; a block's swing is its maximum minus its minimum. A block is an artifact when its swing is more than ratio_max times the median swing of the last memory_blocks blocks (itself included). The verdict is POOR from then until hold_blocks blocks have passed, the artifact block included. The block still being filled counts as soon as its swing so far exceeds ratio_max times the last median.
artifact.developed_on: Our own recordings (tb01, tb02, dual01-03) and, as a check that clean and noisy ECG is not rejected by it, all 48 MIT-BIH Arrhythmia records and the 12 MIT-BIH Noise Stress Test records (analysis/sqi_artifact_dev.txt). All of it is development data. The transients it is aimed at occur in two recordings (tb02's first 42 s, a 16 s burst in tb01), so nothing here is validated on unseen data.
